question: Can strict confirmation remain a quality filter while confirmed factual state is decoupled from immediate entry, without enlarging chase range or relaxing any production parameter?

cohort.definition: Every existing SETUP_01/02 first-entry CONFIRMED event; separately report incumbent ENTRY_ALLOWED/executed and primary first-fail ABOVE_ENTRY_ZONE cohort. No post-result removals.

fixed_geometry: T-known nearest-first targets including provenance; never replace T1 with T2/T3
5% minimum gross T1 upside and 2R at retest plan/actual OPEN

A.name: CONFIRMED_T1_OPEN_RETEST
A.pending_fact: Retain confirmed geometry even if confirmation CLOSE above Entry Zone. A recovered pending plan is a previously non-ENTRY_ALLOWED event with provable frozen geometry/target and unexhausted T1; it is not a production plan.
A.execution: Check only exact T+1 OPEN, frozen Entry Zone/invalidation, T1 >=5% remaining upside, actual RR >=2 and existing target reasonableness; reuse incumbent exact-session OPEN executor. Do not read T+1 HIGH/LOW/CLOSE to decide A.

B.name: CONFIRMED_FIRST_CLOSE_RETEST
B.eligibility: Residual events not executed by incumbent or A at T+1. Missing exact T+1 proof terminates B; do not fall forward.
B.signal: Strict as-of replay, find first CLOSE within frozen zone before any existing termination. First close must satisfy frozen T1 >=5%, RR >=2 and existing target reasonableness. If first retest fails, record reason and do not seek a later close.
B.execution: Only exact next-session OPEN after retest plan; frozen zone/invalidation/5%/2R rechecked through existing executor; next-open skip ends observation.
termination_precedence: CLOSE <= frozen structural invalidation (existing close-based structure rule); T+1 OPEN <= invalidation terminates immediately
existing candidate extraction becomes ineligible or its existing lifecycle key changes, or replay lifecycle changes
known HIGH >= frozen T1; confirmation-day HIGH is known at T close; T+1 OPEN >= T1 also exhausts before B
first close in frozen Entry Zone
B.context_source: Existing trading.setup01/02._candidate_from_wave and candidate.key plus strict-as-of replay lifecycle; no new context thresholds.
B.same_session_ambiguity: Any known structural/context/T1 termination before a close plan wins conservatively; never infer a favorable intraday ordering.

dimensions: EARLY vs LATE confirmation-session market-union midpoint
symbol concentration and excluding top count symbol
reporting.conservation: One original event/lifecycle per confirmed fact, at most one execution per event; incumbent/A/B executable sets mutually disjoint. Separate events, plans, executions and terminal reasons. Preserve original event snapshots.
reporting.latency: Market-session ordinals, first retest close latency distribution and exact next-session execution; no calendar-day substitutions.
reporting.outputs: Compact aggregate JSON/Markdown only, no raw bars or event dumps
reporting.post_entry_outcomes: None; no performance metrics used or generated.
